findings.text: Device identifier storage spans sixteen bytes and directory cookie verifiers span two words while the client allows up to sixteen transports. Operation bitmap sizing derives from the highest operation number rounded up to whole machine words and then expressed both as long count and as thirty two bit word count.

Access rights use nine distinct single bit values progressing by doubling from read through extended listing. Read corresponds to one, lookup to two, modify to four, extend to eight, delete to sixteen, execute to thirty two, extended read to sixty four, extended write to one hundred twenty eight, and extended list to two hundred fifty six.

Cached attribute validity uses individual bit positions with data at one, access time at two, access credentials at three, access control list at four, forced revalidation at six, label at seven, change at eight, creation time at nine, modification time at ten, size at eleven, other at twelve, deferred data invalidation at thirteen, blocks at fourteen, extended attributes at fifteen, link count at sixteen, mode at seventeen, birth time at eighteen, and uncacheable flag at nineteen. A combined mask groups change with creation, modification, birth, size, link, mode and other as metadata invalid.

Inode lifecycle flags use small integers with stale at one, list membership at two, invalidating at three, preserve unlinked at four, commit needed at nine, commit in flight at ten, stats in flight at eleven, direct mode at twelve, and delegation request at thirteen. Open context flag positions use bad at two, unlock at three, file open at four, synchronous write at five, and direct at six.

Callback operation numbers assign three to getattr and four to recall, then five through fourteen to layout recall, notify, delegation push, recall any, recallable available, recall slot, sequence, wants cancelled, notify lock and notify device, with fifteen for offload and ten thousand forty four for illegal.

Extended attribute creation modes use either at zero, create at one and replace at two. Recall type masks place read delegation at zero, write at one, directory at two, file layout at three, block layout at four, object layout range at eight to nine, and other layout range at twelve to fifteen.

Network location discriminants use name at one, uniform locator at two and numeric address at three. Data versus hole uses zero and one. Change attribute kinds progress from monotonic increase at zero through version counter, version counter without parallel access, time metadata and undefined at four. File layout care hints reuse dense and commit through metadata values and add stripe unit at sixty four and stripe count at one hundred twenty eight.

Layout update diagnostics enumerate fourteen causes starting at unknown zero and continuing through no parallel access, zero length read, metadata threshold, memory shortage, bulk recall, input output test failure, cached discovery, return, retry, blocked, invalid open, layout retrieval and exit.

Client construction uses ready at zero, initialising at one and session initialising at two with negative values signalling failure. Resource tracking uses callback at one, identity mapping at two, renewal at three, stop renewal at four and lease check at five. Behaviour switches span ten positions from reserved port avoidance at zero through retry disconnect, migration, infinite slots, no retransmit timeout, possible migration, no ping, data server, port reuse, parallel use and fatal unreachable at ten. Machine credential protection spans seven levels from minimal at one through cleanup, security info, state identifier, write, commit and parallel cleanup at seven.
Jukebox retry delay equals five scheduler ticks and a dedicated blocked file system data marker uses address value one to signal a special waiting state distinct from empty and valid pointers.

Device identity holds data bytes sized by the device constant for stable naming. Operation maps share storage between longs and words to allow word size independent access. Network address pairs netid with addr for presentation plus netid_len and addr_len for valid lengths. Server location selects via nl4_type between nl4_str_sz with nl4_str for textual name or locator and nl4_addr for binary address.

Access cache entries use rb_node for credential ordered lookup and lru for recency with fsuid and fsgid plus group_info for identity and timestamp for age and mask for rights and rcu_head for deferred free. Lock contexts use count for references and list for membership with open_context for parent and lockowner for ownership plus io_count for active operations and rcu_head for deferred free. Local state uses ro_file with rw_file for server backed handles and list for enumeration with nfs_uuid for cluster identity, all reset by the initializer when enabled and otherwise untouched.

Open state builds on lock_context for shared locking and adds flock_owner for flock identity with dentry for path plus cred for authorization and ll_cred for low level expiry and state for version four with mode for access and error for status and flags for lifecycle and mdsthreshold for layout hints, linked through list with rcu_head for deferred free and nfl for local handling. Directory iteration uses list for enumeration with cache_hits and cache_misses for statistics plus attr_gencount for change detection and verf for cookie validation with dir_cookie and last_cookie for position and page_index for offset and dtsize for sizing and force_clear with eof for control and rcu_head for deferred free.

Inode wrapper holds fh for server identity with flags for lifecycle and cache_validity for attribute state plus btime for creation and uncacheable_file_data for caching policy and read_cache_jiffies with attrtimeo and attrtimeo_timestamp for timeout control plus attr_gencount for generation and access_cache with two recency lists for permission caching. Type dependent storage offers cache_change_attribute with cookieverf and rmdir_sem for directories to track change and guard removal, versus nrequests with redirtied_pages and commit_info with commit_mutex for files to account writes and guard commit. Remaining members provide open_files for shared mappings with ooo for gap tracking via cnt and gap pairs of start and end, plus version four nfs4_acl with open_states and delegation and rwsem and layout, counters write_io with read_io, optional xattr_cache and final vfs_inode or netfs embedding.

Copy tracking links copies for global enumeration with src_copies for source grouping and carries stateid for protocol identity with completion for waiting and count for progress and verf for validation and error with flags for status plus parent_src_state with parent_dst_state for lineage. Legacy lock uses state for protocol code with owner for holder and list for enumeration while version four lock keeps only owner for holder.

Client identity uses cl_count with cl_mds_count for references and cl_cons_state for build with cl_res_state and cl_flags for resources and behaviour plus cl_addr with cl_addrlen and cl_hostname with cl_acceptor for naming and cl_share_link with cl_superblocks for linkage. Transport uses cl_rpcclient with rpc_ops and cl_proto and cl_nfs_mod plus cl_minorversion with connection counts and principal and security. Version four keeps cl_ds_clients with cl_clientid and cl_confirm and cl_state guarded by cl_lock with cl_lease_time and cl_last_renewal and cl_renewd and cl_rpcwaitq plus cl_idmap and cl_owner_id with cl_cb_ident and cl_mvops and cl_mig_gen and cl_slot_tbl and cl_seqid and cl_exchange_flags and cl_session with preservation and owner scope implementation and cl_sp4_flags with lock waiting. Tail holds cl_ipaddr with cl_net and tracker and pending list and rcu plus boot time with boot lock and uuid and probe work.

Attribute caching records start time and assumed lifetime with last update moment and generation. Validity expires when current time minus start reaches or exceeds lifetime, so zero lifetime forces immediate revalidation. Successful revalidation lengthens lifetime up to directory or file maximum while failure shortens it to the corresponding minimum.

Out of order change tracking optionally allocates a table holding up to sixteen start and end pairs with a live count. Matching forward and reverse pairs cancel, replies that advance the version without gap leave no entry, and mismatched predecessor plus consequent version change create entries that later replies may fill. Opening with unresolved gaps treats them as external changes and discards cached data, while allocation failure simply disables caching for that inode.

Validity mask distinguishes data, times, access, list, label, change, size, blocks, extended attributes, link, mode, birth and uncacheable aspects with a dedicated deferred flag and a combined metadata mask. Revalidation marking always invalidates access credentials, list, change, creation and size and additionally invalidates data for directories. Clearing deferred state releases the out of order table while testing reports deferred flag or positive gap count.

Revalidation marking serializes validity updates under the inode spin protection. Directory removal uses a read write semaphore with background deletes as readers and removal as writer. File commit state is guarded by a dedicated mutex. Client state carries its own spin protection with a separate sequencing lock for boot time, while delegations, low level credentials and local files rely on read copy update with deferred heads in access, lock, open, directory and client objects.

Client renewal and remote procedure waiting use delayed work with dedicated wait queues for general remote calls and for lock progress, while local boot timestamp updates are ordered by a sequence lock and probe work runs asynchronously.

Small accessors derive the filesystem specific inode, superblock, handle, server, client, protocol table and minimum and maximum attribute lifetimes from generic inode or superblock inputs, choosing directory versus file lifetimes by testing the mode.

Additional helpers test staleness, mark selected validity bits with directory sensitive data handling, check server capabilities, snapshot the directory change counter, report pending writebacks for regular files only, clamp sixty four bit sizes to the file offset limit, and clear or test deferred invalidation with its gap table.

Lifetime helpers release labels and attribute bundles and file handles tolerating empty inputs, extract open state and credentials from file objects, initialize local state conditionally, and provide constant sysctl registration results.

Headers expose portable file type tests for directories and regular files, network file system specific size and permission constants, inode and client layouts with their inline accessors, and conditional debug display and logging macros that compile to active checks when debugging is enabled and to inert forms otherwise.

Client objects progress from initialising through session initialising to ready, with negative construction codes indicating failure. Resource bring up separately tracks callback, mapping and renewal startup with flags for stopping renewal and for lease rechecking, while behaviour switches remain stable after creation.

Attribute lifetime cycles between lengthening on success and shortening to minimum on failure, gated by start time comparison. Layout handling moves through diagnostic reasons from unknown and resource or threshold blocks through cached discovery and retrieval to return, retry or exit, with layout commit and stats flags marking required versus in flight work.

Several layouts overlay alternative views in shared storage, including directory versus file inode data, machine word versus thirty two bit operation maps, and string versus numeric server addresses, so readers must consult the discriminant before interpreting bytes. A reserved address value one marks blocked file data and must be compared explicitly rather than dereferenced. Debug display and hashing change behaviour with build configuration, returning zero and suppressing output when disabled, so callers must not rely on hash stability. Local initialization is a no operation when its feature is off.

Delegation, low level credential and local file pointers require read copy update grace before reclamation, with dedicated heads provided for that purpose. Request counters and cache hit indicators use atomic updates suitable for concurrent paths. Out of order tracking caps at sixteen gaps with on demand allocation, so overflow or allocation failure must fall back to uncached operation. Zero lifetimes intentionally force revalidation because expiry uses greater or equal comparison.
